title: Umutima w'ubugwaneza mu bahanuzi .
intro: Ijwi rihamagara ubugororotsi risubiramwo biciye mu mirongo ya Korowani y’icubahiro. Uwo mutima w’umuhezagiro warahawe ubuhanuzi n’ivyanditswe vy’Imana mu gihe ubuyobozi bwari bukenewe cane mu Bana ba Isirayeli. Uwo muntu yaravugishije abantu biwe ata guca ku ruhande, abahimiriza kwibuka Umukama wabo. Biciye ku kwihangana no ku kwihebera Imana, baracitse itara ry’umuco inkuru yaryo imurikira amapaji y’ivyanditswe vyeranda. Woba ushobora kumenya uwo muntu atangaje izina ryiwe ryubahwa muri Korowani no mu Nkuru Nziza?
clues: Narateye iteka ubuhanuzi n’igitabu co mw’ijuru mu gihe abantu banje bari bakeneye.
Mawe yamvyaye mu buryo butangaje, biciye ku itegeko ry’Imana rya Allah gusa.
Nabwiye abantu banje nti: ‘Ewe bene Isirayeli! Ndi intumwa ya Allah kuri mwebwe, nemeza ivyo vyaje imbere yanje.’
Naje mfise ibimenyetso bitomoye bivuye ku Mwami wawe, nzanye inkuru nziza y’umuhanuzi azoba yitwa Ahmad.
Mawe yari umugore w’umugororotsi yanyebeye gukorera Allah kuva nkiri muto.
Allah yanyigishije Quran maze angira impuhwe n’inshingano kuri mama, kandi sinari umuntu w’ubwibone canke uwutumvira.

identity.label: Jewe ndi nde?
options: Umuhanuzi Muhamadi صلى الله عليه وسلم

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Yarongoye Abisirayeli ngo basubire mu kwizera .

arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ يَـٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيْكُم مُّصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَىَّ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَمُبَشِّرًۢا بِرَسُولٍۢ يَأْتِى مِنۢ بَعْدِى ٱسْمُهُۥٓ أَحْمَدُ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verse: And [mention] when Jesus, the son of Mary, said, "O Children of Israel, indeed I am the messenger of Allāh to you confirming what came before me of the Torah and bringing good tidings of a messenger to come after me, whose name is Aḥmad." But when he came to them with clear evidences, they said, "This is obvious magic." (61:6)
